# Attribution for imported instance files

The files listed in `ledger.json` are configurations from the repositories below.
Their authors and contributors retain copyright. The full license and retained
copyright/notice texts are under `../../licenses/instances/`; `notices.json` binds
every copy to an immutable upstream URL and SHA-256.

## CC-BY-4.0 credits

- **Chalarangelo and the 30 seconds of code contributors**: four workflow files
  from [Chalarangelo/30-seconds-of-code](https://github.com/Chalarangelo/30-seconds-of-code).
- **Free Ebook Foundation and free-programming-books contributors**: one workflow
  from [EbookFoundation/free-programming-books](https://github.com/EbookFoundation/free-programming-books).

These five files remain under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Changes: the original YAML was parsed and serialized as JSON, with the collector
preprocessing of the `on` key and comments; formatting and source comments were
removed. Exact original file links, revisions, and conversion evidence are
recorded for each local file in `ledger.json`. The original license text is
included with each repository notice. No endorsement is implied.
